Container.Name: MagguuBot

Branch.TagDescription: Stable build from main (auto-published via GitHub Actions)

Container.Overview: Discord bot for the download side of a media homelab (Sonarr / Radarr / Seerr / Tautulli / SABnzbd / Prowlarr) with moderation, XP/leveling, reminders, reaction-role panels, starboard, automod, welcome/audit, a GitHub webhook feed, and an optional WoW Blue-Tracker RSS channel (Retail + PTR only). Slash commands include /queue, /arr-status, /calendar, /search, /db-backup, /purge. Ships with an embedded admin dashboard (Discord OAuth2, warnings/XP/webhook views, filterable) at DASHBOARD_BASE_URL. Channel IDs are auto-discovered + persisted by /setup-server into SQLite — no template edits required for channel routing. Role-gated channels: Newcomer sees only Info/Chat, Plex-User/Regular/VIP unlock MEDIA + DOWNLOADS. Single container, runs headless with an append-only activity log under /app/data.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port that receives webhooks from *arr services + SABnzbd + GitHub. Only expose to LAN. Containers on the same Docker network reach it via http://MagguuBot:3000 without any port mapping.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: SQLite database + WAL files. Persists channel config, warnings, reminders, XP, webhook history across container rebuilds.

Config.Name: DISCORD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bot token from Discord Developer Portal (Applications -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token). Treat as a password.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Application ID from Discord Developer Portal (Applications -> your app -> General).

Config.Name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
Config.Description: Your Discord server ID. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, right-click the server icon, Copy Server ID.

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Shared secret required in X-Magguu-Token for Sonarr, Radarr, Seerr, Tautulli, and SABnzbd. Prowlarr passes it as Bearer header or ?token=. GitHub uses GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32 (minimum 16 chars).

Config.Name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: HMAC secret for the /webhook/github endpoint. Set the same value in each GitHub repo's Settings -> Webhooks -> Secret. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32. Leave empty to disable the GitHub feed.

Config.Name: STATUS_API_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bearer token for the read-only GET /api/status JSON (uptime, build SHA, last webhook per source) used by the Home Assistant dashboard. Generate: openssl rand -hex 32. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Client Secret (Reset then paste). Required for the admin dashboard login. Leave empty to disable the dashboard entirely.

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Signs the HTTP-only dashboard session for up to 30 days. Generate once with: openssl rand -hex 32 (minimum 16 chars), then keep it unchanged across updates. Rotate only to invalidate all sessions.

Config.Name: ADMIN_USER_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to log into the dashboard. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, right-click your profile, Copy User ID.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS origin without a path (e.g. https://bot.example.com). Local WebUI browser requests redirect here automatically. Must exactly match the redirect URI origin in Discord Developer Portal -> OAuth2 -> Redirects (with /auth/callback appended).

Config.Name: SONARR_URL
Config.Description: Sonarr base URL. http://sonarr:8989 works when both containers share a Docker network, otherwise http://UNRAID-IP:8989.

Config.Name: SONARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Sonarr API key from Settings -> General. Required for /queue and /search show.

Config.Name: RADARR_URL
Config.Description: Radarr base URL.

Config.Name: RADARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Radarr API key from Settings -> General.

Config.Name: SEERR_URL
Config.Description: Jellyseerr / Overseerr base URL. Required for Seerr approve/decline buttons.

Config.Name: SEERR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Seerr API key from Settings -> General.

Config.Name: SAB_URL
Config.Description: SABnzbd base URL. Used by /queue for the live slot list.

Config.Name: SAB_API_KEY
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key from Config -> General -> Security.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_URL
Config.Description: Tautulli base URL. Required for /plex-top (Top Filme/Serien/User). Playback-Notifications laufen weiterhin über den Webhook-Agent und brauchen das nicht.

Config.Name: TAUTULLI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Tautulli API key from Settings -> Web Interface -> API.

Config.Name: WOW_BLUE_TRACKER_URL
Config.Description: RSS feed URL for the WoW Blue-Tracker channel. Recommended: https://www.bluetracker.gg/rss/wow/ — bot scrapes each topic page for the full post body (with images) instead of the short RSS snippet. Only [EU] posts are kept (US/KR/TW/CN dropped), and Classic/SoD/Wrath/Cata/Hardcore are filtered by keyword. Posts with less than 250 chars of body are skipped to avoid stub topics. Leave empty to disable the feature entirely.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. OpenAI API key for AI-Moderation (uses the free /v1/moderations endpoint, no tokens consumed). Get one at platform.openai.com/api-keys. Enable the feature via the Settings page in the dashboard. Leave empty to disable — other automod filters are unaffected.

Config.Name: TMDB_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. TMDB v3 API key (themoviedb.org -> Settings -> API). Used as a fallback for Seerr request embeds when Seerr does not include a poster image. 6h in-memory cache. Leave empty to disable — Seerr embeds work without it.

Config.Name: ADDON_REPO_FULL_NAMES
Config.Description: Comma-separated GitHub repos whose release announcements belong in #addon-updates. Technical pushes, workflows, PRs, and issues stay in #github. Case-insensitive.

Config.Name: MAGGUUUI_READ_TOKEN
Config.Description: Read-only GitHub token (contents:read on the private Derpsen/MagguuUI repo). Enables the release poller that posts new MagguuUI releases to #addon-updates. Leave empty to disable.

Config.Name: ADDON_RELEASE_POLL_MINUTES
Config.Description: MagguuUI release poll interval in minutes (0 disables).

Config.Name: FAQ_AUTOANSWER_CHANNEL_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated help channel IDs where the bot answers questions from the website FAQ (ui.magguu.xyz). Empty disables it. Needs the MessageContent intent.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level: trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal

Config.Name: NODE_ENV
Config.Description: Keep as 'production' on Unraid.

Config.Name: HTTP_HOST
Config.Description: Interface to bind the webhook server to.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: IPs/CIDRs of reverse proxies whose cf-connecting-ip / x-forwarded-for / x-real-ip headers are trusted for webhook rate-limit keys (socket peer check), e.g. the cloudflared container IP. Empty = never trust headers. Keywords: private, none. Replaces TRUST_PROXY.

Config.Name: HTTP_PORT
Config.Description: Internal port of the webhook server (must match the port mapping above).

Config.Name: DATABASE_PATH
Config.Description: SQLite database path inside the container (maps through AppData).

Config.Name: TIME_ZONE
Config.Description: IANA timezone used for weekly digest scheduling, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

Config.Name: WEEKLY_DIGEST_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the automatic weekly Discord digest.

Config.Name: WEEKLY_DIGEST_DAY
Config.Description: Digest weekday: 0=Sunday through 6=Saturday.

Config.Name: WEEKLY_DIGEST_HOUR
Config.Description: Local hour (0-23) after which the weekly digest is posted.

Config.Name: PLEX_WEEKLY_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the weekly Plex statistics card (Tautulli, one edited message).

Config.Name: PLEX_WEEKLY_DAY
Config.Description: Plex statistics weekday: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday through 6=Saturday.

Config.Name: PLEX_WEEKLY_HOUR
Config.Description: Local hour (0-23, TIME_ZONE) after which the Plex statistics card is refreshed.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_PLEX_WEEKLY
Config.Description: Optional channel ID for the Plex statistics card (default: weekly digest channel).

Config.Name: AUTOMATIC_BACKUP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Create one automatic SQLite backup per day.

Config.Name: AUTOMATIC_BACKUP_HOUR
Config.Description: Local hour (0-23) after which the daily database backup runs.

Config.Name: AUTOMATIC_BACKUP_RETENTION
Config.Description: Number of daily automatic database backups to retain (1-30).

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_RETRY_ENABLED
Config.Description: Automatically retry webhook deliveries that could not be posted to Discord.

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
Config.Description: Maximum automatic retries per failed webhook event (1-10).

Config.Name: PLEX_ACTIVITY_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Delete old Plex activity cards from Discord after this many days (1-90). Set 0 to keep them forever.

Config.Name: PLEX_STALE_SESSION_MINUTES
Config.Description: Terminate paused or stuck Plex sessions via Tautulli after this many minutes (1-180). Also closes Discord activity cards that no longer have a live session. Set 0 to disable.

Config.Name: PLEX_CARD_CLEANUP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Emergency brake for the one-time removal of the former Plex activity cards (per-user cards must be live first). Set false to never delete anything; also re-checked before every single delete.

Config.Name: PLEX_CARD_CLEANUP_DRY_RUN
Config.Description: true = the cleanup only counts and logs what it would delete (once per process), deletes nothing and persists nothing.

Config.Name: PLEX_CARD_CLEANUP_SCAN_LIMIT
Config.Description: How many recent messages in the Plex channel the cleanup scans (100-2000).

Config.Name: PLEX_CARD_USER_ALIASES
Config.Description: Optional display names for the per-user Plex cards: name=alias,name2=alias2 (or a JSON object). Empty = Plex names as they are.

Config.Name: PLEX_CARD_USER_EXCLUDE
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated Plex user names that get no card.

Config.Name: PLEX_NEW_DIGEST_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the weekly "Neu hinzugefügt" digest (one embed with new additions since the last digest, Tautulli). Nothing new = no message.

Config.Name: PLEX_NEW_DIGEST_DAY
Config.Description: Digest weekday: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday through 6=Saturday (default Friday).

Config.Name: PLEX_NEW_DIGEST_HOUR
Config.Description: Local hour (0-23, TIME_ZONE) after which the digest is posted.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_NEW_ADDED
Config.Description: Optional channel ID for the "Neu hinzugefügt" digest (default: New-on-Plex channel, else the weekly digest channel).

Config.Name: FAQ_TOP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the weekly "FAQ der Woche" embed (most used FAQ question, anonymous counters). No usage = no message.

Config.Name: FAQ_TOP_DAY
Config.Description: FAQ of the week weekday: 0=Sunday, 1=Monday through 6=Saturday.

Config.Name: FAQ_TOP_HOUR
Config.Description: Local hour (0-23, TIME_ZONE) after which the FAQ of the week is posted.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_FAQ_TOP
Config.Description: Optional channel ID for "FAQ der Woche" (default: weekly digest channel).

Config.Name: SERVER_HEALTH_CARD_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the self-updating server health card (members, active users of the week, commands). Needs a channel, otherwise nothing happens.

Config.Name: DISCORD_CHANNEL_SERVER_HEALTH
Config.Description: Optional channel ID for the server health card (default: health/status channel; without a channel no card).

Config.Name: RIO_ROLE_THRESHOLDS
Config.Description: Optional Raider.IO score roles for /rio-link: JSON [{"minScore":2000,"roleId":"..."}] or short form 2000=roleId,2500=roleId (max 15 tiers). Empty = feature off. The roles must already exist, the bot needs Manage Roles and its role above them. /rio-config (Manage Server) can override this at runtime.

Config.Name: RIO_SEASON_LABEL
Config.Description: Optional free-text season label (max 40 characters) shown in /rio-link replies, e.g. Midnight Season 1. The score itself always comes from the current Raider.IO season.
